Possibly the worst Indian food I have eaten.
Jun 2023 • Couples
Words cannot describe my disappointment. There are so many excellent Indian restaurants in Saigon. The bar for food quality is quite high. Choose any of the other restaurants and you will likely have a tasty and satisfying meal. 

Sadly, the currys from Bollywood taste worse than ones that come prepackaged from a western supermarket. The vegetables appear to be from frozen bags. If you order paneer you will need to search hard to find it in your dish. You will also have to hope the chef doesn't lose control of his hand when adding aniseed, which clearly happened with the 4 dishes I ordered. 

With food of this,quality this restaurant won't last long. Until then, watch out.

Delicious Restaurant But Not Easy to Access
Oct 2020
As we were new to the area, I had been exploring the various different Indian restaurants in District 7 and finally came across Bollywood Indian restaurant. As I could see the sign outside but not a way to access it, I called the restaurant and the manager kindly offered to meet me outside as he said it was not easy to find. He met me and was very kind and welcoming. To go to the restaurant we had to walk quite a way through a compound's hot basement with quite a few moto bikes whizzing by and with the scent of strong fumes. Eventually we reached what looked like a small metal fire escape and climbed the stairs into the compound. My heart sank when i saw all the metal steps as no matter how delicious the restaurant turned out to be, my husband is 81 and has difficulty climbing stairs, preferring either a ground floor or a restaurant that can be accessed via an elevator. I asked the manager if we could enter the main gate of the compound and reach the restaurant that way but he said that normal access was reserved for residents only. This turned out to be a great shame as the food was delicious. The poppadums were none greasy, fried to perfection, the pickles extremely tasty. The chicken biryani was amongst the best ever tasted as well as the vindaloo sauce that I asked for. All of the staff were very pleasant and helpful and checked if I was enjoying their food etc. My only regret is the way to the restaurant so that my husband can join me next time as he doesn't really enjoy eating take aways at home
